name: Nueva Expresión Textil, S.A.
summary: Nueva Expresión Textil, S.A. manufactures and sells fabrics and garments. It offers jacquards, meshes, rib, lurex, stripes, simplex, and spacer fabrics, as well as compression textiles. The company also provides luxury garments; sports garments with seamless technology, including both fabric design and garment manufacturing as well as compression fabrics; swimwear; plain and printed intimate and shapewear with a knitted stitch or structure; and medical fabrics that help to delay and prevent medical procedures to correct orthopaedic and postural problems.
